project_name: DeepGreen Western Passage Subsea-Compute & Infrastructure Hub
aliases: DeepGreen Western Passage underwater AI data center
status_detail: DeepGreen applied to FERC for a preliminary permit for a tidal-powered, water-cooled data center in Western Passage; Eastport says no construction permits or local applications have been received, and the City Council has expressed opposition.
notes: Original reporting describes a 51 MW tidal energy/subsea data center concept off Kendall's Head toward Harris Point. Later tracker/news reports suggest amended phasing may reduce early capacity, so 51 MW should be treated as the original proposed headline capacity.

project_name: Sanford Woods Industrial and Technical Campus
developer: Randy Gibbs / Sanford Woods Industrial and Technical Campus
status_detail: Local reporting describes a 1,000-plus acre mixed-use campus with a 100-300 MW data center and 300 MW hydrogen fuel-cell power plant; Sanford's official May 2026 update says no formal data center proposal was under review and the city was considering a 91-day emergency moratorium for data-center regulations.
notes: Capacity is reported as a range of 100-300 MW; 300 MW records the upper bound. Project appears pre-application/speculative from the city's official process statement.
